headline: Pavapuri Trading files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code for Chambal Fertilizers
sum: Pavapuri Trading & Investment Company has filed Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE for a substantial acquisition in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited. The filing triggers mandatory disclosure requirements under SEBI takeover regulations but specific shareholding percentages and consideration values are not yet publicly disclosed.
detail: Pavapuri Trading & Investment Company has submitted a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, following a material acquisition in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited. Regulation 31(4) requires the acquirer to disclose particulars to the stock exchange within two working days of acquisition. The filing was lodged with NSE on 16 June 2026 (document timestamp 11 Jun 2026). Under takeover code provisions, depending on the exact threshold crossed, the acquirer may trigger an open offer obligation or qualify for exemptions under the regulations.
